```{r setup, include = FALSE}
# Root locator: knitr renders with cwd set to the vignettes directory.
.pkg_root <- function() {
  for (dd in c(".", "..", "../..")) {
    if (file.exists(file.path(dd, "DESCRIPTION"))) return(normalizePath(dd))
  }
  NA_character_
}
PKG <- .pkg_root()
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
```

msuiter admits peer comparisons to its public face only as committed
witness bytes. The sanctioned corpus is `bench/results/*/witnesses` (the
sealed campaign witness directories, the bootstrap-vs-sigminer campaigns
among them) plus the atlas comparison sweep at
`bench/scenarios/out/compare_sweep.csv`. Every number inside a peer-value
marker below is a verbatim byte substring of the witness file named on that
marker; the testthat law `tests/testthat/test-peer-evidence.R` re-parses
this page's rendered output and demands exactly that, span by span. Each
campaign card also stamps every witness with an in-process sha256 and a
row census, re-derived from the file bytes at build time.

The page runs no benchmarks and recomputes nothing: it renders what the
sealed witnesses already say. A number with no witness byte behind it
cannot reach this page -- the law's controls fabricate one and watch the
audit name it, drop a scored column and watch the render refuse rather than
zero-fill, and empty the corpus and watch the face redden instead of
passing silently.

```{r peer, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, results = "asis"}
if (is.na(PKG) ||
    !dir.exists(file.path(PKG, "bench", "results")) ||
    !file.exists(file.path(PKG, "tools", "peer-evidence.R"))) {
  cat("rendered outside the committed witness corpus: this page prints no number here;\nre-derive the stamps with `Rscript tools/peer-evidence.R --out=<dir>` from the repository root\n")
} else {
  Sys.setenv(MSUITER_TOOL_NO_MAIN = "1")
  source(file.path(PKG, "tools", "peer-evidence.R"), local = TRUE)
  cat(paste0(c("<div class=\"peer-evidence\">", spe_render(PKG), "</div>"),
             collapse = "\n"))
  cat("\n")
  Sys.unsetenv("MSUITER_TOOL_NO_MAIN")
}
```

To re-derive every stamp yourself, run
`Rscript tools/peer-evidence.R --out=<dir>` from the repository root and
diff its `manifest.tsv` against what you see here.
